key_claims.claim: A consistent prenatal ultrasound pattern of early IUGR, microcephaly, ACC, intracranial cysts, and lissencephaly characterizes RNU4ATAC-associated MOPD1 and can guide targeted genetic testing.
Machine learning models using third-trimester biometry and Doppler offer only marginal improvement over logistic regression for predicting LGA with adverse outcomes.
Fetoscopic laser ablation of type II and type III vasa previa achieves 100 percent perinatal survival with comparable outcomes, and outpatient management appears feasible.

Lesion volume ratio thresholds of greater than 11 cm² for hemorrhage risk and greater than 4 cm² for delivery complications may guide counseling and EXIT planning for fetal non-nuchal lymphatic malformations.
MRI-derived cervical length correlates with TVS but has insufficient sensitivity and specificity to replace TVS for short cervix diagnosis.
